prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sprite sheet called The Small Desk Society. Original image inputs guide complete footless continuous charcoal-plum splat silhouettes, tiny goo hands, thick sculpted filled eyelids, ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil. The fictional Schulkinder are conveyed through relative body proportions, facial attitude and props. All are soft organic ink blobs with simple age-appropriate clothing accents. No actual humans. Six independent full characters in a strict 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet, 1536×1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Equal substantial scale within this sheet. Keep silhouettes and all props within generous clear alpha gutters and canvas margins. No background scene, shadow disc, frame, text, logo or branding. Smooth softly satin handmade plasticine with sparse larger modeled marks, broad fabric folds, smooth glass and finished plastic. No grit or crust. Teeth behind lips. No inherited reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Bright muted cobalt, ochre, brick and pale green. Casual school clothes with one large school prop per blob.
Row-major cast:
1. Female-read eager schoolbag packer. short upright curl, raised eager brows and smile. Key cue: compact school satchel bulging with one visible exercise book.
2. Male-read frustrated pencil owner. wide low blob, clenched expression. Key cue: one short broken pencil, two blunt pieces held together.
3. Male-read hopeful lunchbox trader. round droplet, sidelong hopeful eyes and crooked closed smile. Key cue: small open lunchbox with one triangular sandwich inside.
4. Female-read meticulous eraser collector. tall curled bean, downturned intense gaze and tight little mouth. Key cue: three rounded multicolored erasers stacked in hand.
5. Male-read imaginative school tinkerer. broad asymmetrical blob, lifted curious gaze and half smile. Key cue: two short wooden rulers fastened as a tiny bridge.
6. Male-read impatient recess watcher. squat square blob, one lid narrowed, impatient pout. Key cue: tiny blank clock face on a simple wrist strap raised near face.
All six whole ink blobs are distinct and easy to isolate. Simple readable surreal props and varied expressions.
